functions.name: BlockingStarted
functions.docs:
This provides a mechanism to connect the engine (the client) to a movie player (the server).
Engine code can call BlockingStarted/Tick/Finished around blocking areas.
The movie player can call RegisterServer/UnregisterServer
so it can receive the calls from the engine.

functions.name: BlockingTick
functions.docs: Call this periodically during a blocking operation on the game thread.

functions.name: BlockingFinished
functions.docs: Call this once the blocking operation is done to shut down the movie player.

functions.name: BlockingForceFinished
functions.docs: Call this to make sure the movie player is no longer running.

functions.name: SetIsSlateThreadAllowed
functions.docs: Call this to prevent the movie player from using the Slate thread.

functions.name: RegisterServer
functions.docs: Call this to hook up a server.

functions.name: UnregisterServer
functions.docs: Call this to unregister the current server.
